opportunities.title: Telegram Automation Script for Marketers
opportunities.description: I want to add a new, production-ready Telegram automation script to my portfolio of marketing tools—this one aimed squarely at professional marketers and agencies. The goal is to streamline repetitive chat tasks, free up campaign managers’ time, and offer them a plug-and-play solution they can deploy under their own brand. Here is what matters most to me: • Commercial-grade code. A clean, well-documented code-base (Python or Node.js preferred, but I’m open to stronger arguments for something else) that I can maintain and extend after delivery. • Easy deployment. The script should work out-of-the-box on a typical VPS or in Docker, with a concise setup guide. • White-label ready. Clear configuration files, language files, and a straightforward licensing check so I can package and resell. • Marketing-centric features. While we’ll pin down the exact feature list together, everything should focus on the day-to-day workflow of agencies—think lead capture hooks, broadcast logic, basic analytics endpoints and other quality-of-life touches that teams expect. Process We’ll move in short milestones: initial architecture proposal, MVP, polish & packaging. Each stage closes with a quick code review and a test run on my server. If you have solid Telegram bot experience and can point me to prior projects (especially anything sold commercially), let’s talk. Please include the tech stack you’d like to use and a brief outline of how you would keep the code easily brandable for resale.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40781757, publicado hace 7 horas (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: USD 2 - 8.

opportunities.title: Bill.com Vendor Email Automation
opportunities.description: I need a flow built in Power Automate that listens for the “new vendor created” event in Bill.com and immediately sends an email to several internal recipients. The message must pull the vendor’s name, payment details, and account number straight from the Bill.com record so the accounting team has all critical information at a glance. Here’s what I have in mind: • Trigger: New-vendor creation in Bill.com, captured through the official connector or a secure API call. • Action: Compose and send an Outlook (or comparable SMTP) email to our predefined distribution list. • Data mapping: Vendor Name, Payment Details, Account Number inserted into a clear, branded email template. • Error handling: Log failures and notify me if the flow cannot retrieve data or deliver the message. Acceptance criteria: 1. Creating a test vendor in our Bill.com sandbox fires exactly one email within 30 seconds. 2. All three data points arrive correctly formatted. 3. The flow can be turned on/off and edited by our admin without code changes. Access to our Bill.com API key and recipient addresses will be provided after kickoff. If you’ve connected Power Automate to Bill.com before—or built similar event-driven notifications—let me know your approach and estimated setup time.

opportunities.title: AutoCAD Video Module for Design Course -- 2
opportunities.description: Title: AutoCAD Instructor: Record a Video Module for an Interior Design Course (From Scratch) Job Description: We are looking for an experienced AutoCAD instructor or an interior designer with top-tier drafting skills to record a comprehensive, beginner-friendly video learning module. The module will be integrated into our "Interior Design from Scratch" online course. During the course, our students receive a real property project brief and an empty floor plan. The goal of your module is to teach them AutoCAD fundamentals completely from scratch and guide them through creating their own individual floor plan based on the provided brief. Key Responsibilities: • Plan and record a step-by-step video module teaching AutoCAD to absolute beginners. • Guide students through the software interface, essential tools, and drafting workflows. • Use a real-world empty floor plan to demonstrate how to build an interior layout from a project brief. Approximate outline of what needs to be recorded: Module 1. Getting Started with AutoCAD • How to Successfully Complete the Module • Installing AutoCAD • Lesson 1. Downloading and Installing AutoCAD. How to install AutoCAD on your computer or laptop. Essential AutoCAD library for getting started. • Lesson 2. Getting Started and Essential Tools. How AutoCAD works. Understanding the interface and the essential tools you need to get started. • Lesson 3. Creating Geometric Shapes: Dimensions, Layers, and Properties Working with shapes, adding dimensions, using layers, and saving drawings. • Lesson 4. Creating a Technical Detail: Hatching and Projections. Creating a technical detail drawing and side view. Different types of hatching and how they are used. • Lesson 5. Creating a Measured Floor Plan. Applying your AutoCAD skills in practice. Transferring on-site measurements into AutoCAD and creating a measured floor plan. • Lesson 6. Room Schedule and Area Calculations. Creating a room schedule based on the measured floor plan. Room numbering and area calculations. • Lesson 7. Blocks and Groups. Creating blocks, understanding their properties and functionality, and working with furniture blocks. Module 2. Space Planning • Lesson 1. Introduction to Space Planning. Core principles of space planning. Ergonomics. Common technical mistakes. Understanding what clients typically expect from a space plan. • Lesson 2. Working with Small Spaces • Lesson 3. Space Planning in AutoCAD. Creating a space plan in AutoCAD. Drawing walls, placing furniture, adding furniture dimensions, and developing wall and partition plans. Requirements: • Good English communication skills with clear, articulate pronunciation. • Ability to explain complex technical concepts in simple, accessible terms for beginners. Even if you haven't recorded similar lessons before, but you are confident you can handle it, please apply! • Expertise in AutoCAD applied specifically to interior design/architecture. Project Scope & Timeline: Please submit your proposals stating your estimated timeline and your fixed price for the complete course structure outlined above. How to Apply: • Please attach a couple of your drawings and confirm your readiness to record a 5-minute sample video after agreeing on the terms, so we can hear how you explain. • In your proposal, please state your approximate price for recording the entire volume of these modules.

opportunities.title: Exact Word to PDF Conversion
opportunities.description: I have a set of Microsoft Word files that must be turned into PDFs without a single shift in layout, font, margin, or spacing. Every visual and interactive element—images, tables, graphics, signatures, logos, embedded links, forms, and bookmarks—needs to appear and function exactly as it does in the original .docx. Please use whatever combination of Word’s own exporter, Adobe Acrobat, or other reliable PDF tools you trust, as long as the final files look pixel-perfect beside the source documents. I will review each PDF against the original, checking that: • All pages render identically (no text reflow or missing objects) • Hyperlinks, form fields, and internal bookmarks remain active • Resolution of images and logos is preserved • File opens cleanly in standard PDF readers without warnings Deliverable: one high-quality PDF for every Word document I provide, ready for immediate distribution.

opportunities.title: Luxury Clinic Reception Design
opportunities.description: I’m opening a new aesthetic clinic and would like to start with a truly memorable reception and waiting area. The look I’m aiming for is unmistakably luxury and elegant, yet calm, using a palette of beige, soft neutrals and generous touches of marble. Here’s what I need from you: • A refined floor-plan that makes check-in effortless and guides clients smoothly toward treatment rooms. • Mood board and material specifications that capture the beige-marble scheme without drifting into cold minimalism. • High-quality 3D visualisations (or photorealistic renders) so I can see lighting, textures and furniture in context. • A concise finishes schedule noting paints, stone, fixtures, lighting and suggested furniture brands. All drawings should be delivered in editable format (CAD or SketchUp/Revit) along with print-ready PDFs. 3D imagery can be in Lumion/Enscape/V-Ray—whatever you prefer, as long as the final files are high resolution. Once the reception concept is approved I plan to roll the same language through the rest of the clinic, so a cohesive design approach is important. Please share relevant portfolio pieces that showcase luxury, elegance and thoughtful space planning.

opportunities.title: Nepal 2D & 3D Animation
opportunities.description: I have a creative concept that calls for a series of high-quality 2D and 3D animations centred solely on Nepal. The content is intentionally different from standard tourism spots, classroom explainers, or straight-forward product ads; it will tell its own story and reach a niche audience outside the usual categories. Because of this “other” focus, the visuals must feel fresh while still remaining unmistakably Nepali in tone and detail. Here is the outline of what I need: • A complete production pipeline—from initial storyboard through final render—delivered in Full-HD (1080p) or higher. • Mixed 2D and 3D sequences that flow together seamlessly, including any modelling, rigging, texturing, compositing, and motion graphics needed. • Authentic references: accurate colours, motifs, and environmental cues so that every frame immediately evokes Nepal even though the subject matter is not limited to landmarks, festivals, or wildlife. • Source files (Maya/Blender/Cinema 4D, After Effects, Illustrator, etc.) alongside the final mastered video so I can create future versions. • Two rounds of revisions to fine-tune pacing, lighting, and colour grade. Acceptance criteria 1. Storyboard approved before full production begins. 2. Final video matches agreed timing and resolution, without frame-drops or artefacts. 3. All assets supplied in organised project folders with clear naming conventions. If you have a show-reel that blends 2D and 3D work—especially pieces where you developed a culturally specific look—that will help me gauge fit quickly. I’m ready to start as soon as I find the right partner.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40781659, publicado hace 8 horas (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: USD 10 - 30.

The focus is on two areas: first, refining the overall site layout to ensure lot lines, grading, setbacks, and easements are presented exactly as the planning department now requests; second, re-working the utility and drainage systems so the water, sewer, and storm-water details all comply with current code. I already have the full set of digital CAD files and PDFs from the original submission, so you will be building directly on that base rather than starting from scratch. Please keep the existing layering and title-block standards intact while incorporating the revisions. AutoCAD Civil 3D (or an equivalent compatible format) is preferred for all edits. Deliverables I’m expecting: • Updated site layout plan (DWG + PDF) • Revised utility & drainage plan with profiles and schedules (DWG + PDF) • Any supporting calculations or notes the city commonly asks for (hydrology tables, pipe sizing, etc.) • The plans have to be stamped and approved. Once the drawings are complete, I’d like a handoff meeting to walk through the changes so I’m fully prepared for the resubmittal. I want them fully ready to submit by me or even better by you, making sure that they're meeting all of the city requirements for Lake Havasu City, Arizona. This is a 1.3 acre Parcel in a desert environment and the prior civil plans were complete but have expired. I will supply the current plans to the winning party.

opportunities.title: Unique Teen Cartoon Concept & Animation
opportunities.description: I’m building a brand-new YouTube channel aimed squarely at teenagers and I want to launch it with an original animated style that doesn’t fit the usual buckets of “funny kids’ stories”, “educational shorts”, or generic adventure pieces. The subject matter will also step outside the standard comedy, fantasy, or self-help lanes; I have a rough vision, but I need a creative partner to shape it into a clear, standout concept and then bring the first video to life. Here’s what I’d like to tackle together: • Channel Concept – refine the core premise, visual identity, episode length, posting cadence, and overall tone so the channel feels coherent and binge-worthy for a teen audience. • Pilot Script & Storyboard – develop a tight narrative arc that shows off the concept and hooks viewers within the first seconds. • Animation Production – create a polished short (2–4 minutes) in full HD with voice-over, sound design, and simple motion graphics; tool choice is open (Toon Boom, Adobe Animate, Blender, or equivalent) as long as the final render is clean and YouTube-ready. • Thumbnail & Title – one eye-catching thumbnail plus a title that drives clicks without resorting to clickbait. Acceptance criteria – Concept deck (PDF or Slides) summarising theme, style frames, and episode roadmap. – Final MP4 video exported at 1080p, ≤100 MB, free of copyrighted assets. – Separate deliverables: storyboard PDF, layered project files, and thumbnail PNG. If you thrive on creating something that feels fresh, quirky, and undeniably teen-friendly, let’s start sketching ideas and get this pilot published.

opportunities.title: Plastic Hanger Extension Arm Production
opportunities.description: I’m taking my plastic clothes-hanger extension arm into manufacturing and need a partner who can drive the project from the sample on my desk to a fully documented, factory-ready package. You will start with the physical sample and accompanying CAD files I already have, refine them for efficient, defect-free injection-molding, and deliver everything a molder needs to quote and run a first production batch. Key outcomes I expect: • Optimised 3D model and 2D drawings ready for tooling • Design-for-manufacture analysis with material and gate recommendations • Complete bill of materials, finishing notes, and packaging specs • Step-by-step manufacturing plan, including prototype, pilot run, QC checkpoints, and final scale-up • Estimated cycle time, unit cost and mold cost projections Please attach a detailed project proposal outlining milestones, the software and processes you use (SolidWorks, Moldflow, AutoCAD, etc.), and examples of similar plastic parts you have taken into production. I will supply the existing CAD and ship the physical sample once we agree on terms.

opportunities.title: Teleoperador de Seguros por Comisión
opportunities.description: Teleoperador/a de seguros con experiencia. Remoto, horario de España, solo comisión. Agencia de seguros en Toledo (España) busca una persona con experiencia demostrable en venta telefónica de seguros para llamar a nuestra cartera de clientes y vender cuatro ramos: hogar, decesos, vida y accidentes, y salud. Renovaciones, seguimiento de presupuestos y venta cruzada a clientes que ya nos conocen. Sin captación en frío a particulares. Condiciones: unas 3 horas al día en horario comercial de España (mañanas o tardes a convenir), colaboración mercantil por objetivos. Sin fijo: cobras el 50 % de la comisión que la aseguradora paga a la agencia por cada póliza nueva que consigas, durante el primer año de la póliza, al cobro del primer recibo. La agencia cobra el 15 % de la prima en hogar, decesos, vida y accidentes, y el 10 % en salud: tu parte es el 7,5 % y el 5 % de cada prima. opportunities.title: Off-Grid Solar Refrigeration Design
opportunities.description: I need a complete technical design for an off-grid solar power system with batteries dedicated to running a refrigeration load. The goal is a reliable, year-round solution that can handle start-up surge and maintain temperature stability even through several cloudy days. Scope of work • Analyse the refrigeration unit’s power profile (running watts, surge, duty cycle) and translate that into daily kWh demand, autonomy requirements, and peak loads. • Size the PV array, battery bank (preferably LiFePO4), inverter/charger, MPPT controllers, cabling, and protections so that the system meets those demands with at least two days of autonomy. • Provide a single-line diagram, equipment list with model suggestions, and all necessary wiring details. • Include efficiency, voltage-drop, and temperature-compensation calculations plus brief notes on grounding and over-current protection in line with NEC or relevant local standards. • Deliver editable files (PDF plus native format—AutoCAD, SketchUp, or similar) and a concise design report explaining assumptions and calculations. Acceptance criteria 1. Array, battery, and inverter capacities are justified by load and climate data. 2. Documents are clear enough for a licensed electrician to build the system without further clarification. 3. All components are commercially available in my region or have equivalent substitutes listed. If you are experienced in PV sizing, battery chemistry selection, and off-grid design software such as PVsyst, Helioscope, or Homer, I’d love to review a quick outline of your proposed approach and timeline.

opportunities.title: CATIA V5 Models & Drawings
opportunities.description: I have a small batch of components that must be built in CATIA V5 2022, strictly on a licensed seat of the software. You will receive PDFs or scanned sketches that already carry most critical dimensions; the rest can be inferred once we start a quick clarification call. Here’s what I expect for every item: • 3D part models - 4 • Assembly models (where applicable) - 1 • Fully-detailed part and assembly drawings - 5 Native CATPart, CATProduct, and CATDrawing files are mandatory; neutral formats (STEP, PDF) are welcome as extras but not essential. To move forward, share a link—or a short PDF portfolio—showing CATIA work you have personally produced on a licensed installation. Once this pilot run is signed off, I have a steady stream of similar jobs waiting.

opportunities.title: LAPU Recharge & Payment Automation
opportunities.description: My immediate priority is to remove the manual steps that still slow down our LAPU recharge workflow. I need a developer who can take the “Recharge and payment processing” module and make it fully hands-free. The automated flow must: • Accept payments coming in through mobile money and bank transfers. • As soon as the payment lands, trigger the recharge to the right SIM, send the customer a confirmation (SMS or push is fine), match the transaction to the correct customer account in our database, and write a clean payment record that rolls into a daily summary report. I am happy to expose current APIs, database schemas and wallet callbacks so you can plug straight in. The end result should let an operator glance at the dashboard and see reconciled balances, successful recharges, and the auto-generated daily report without touching a single spreadsheet. Deliverables will be: 1. A working codebase or integration script that carries out the full flow above in our staging environment. 2. Deployment instructions and minimal documentation so our in-house team can move it to production. 3. A brief hand-over session to walk through the logic and confirm all post-payment actions fire reliably. If you have experience with LAPU gateways, mobile money APIs or similar real-time payment automation, I’d like to get this moving quickly.

opportunities.title: Engineer-Level Foundation Repair Plan
opportunities.description: I need a comprehensive, engineer-level repair plan to address cracks that have appeared in the interior walls and ceilings of my single-family home. The pattern of cracking suggests an underlying foundation issue rather than simple drywall movement, so the plan must pinpoint root causes and lay out corrective steps that bring the structure back to full integrity and code compliance. What I expect from you: • A brief written diagnosis of why the foundation is stressing the interior partitions. • Scaled drawings or sketches that illustrate where underpinning, crack stitching, or other structural corrections should go. • Calculations or rationale (load paths, soil bearing checks, etc.) that justify the chosen solution. • A phased work sequence specifying materials, curing times, and any temporary shoring. • Notes for local permit approval—references to the applicable residential code and, if you are licensed, an engineering stamp ready for submission. Acceptance criteria: the plan must be complete enough for a contractor to price and execute without further structural input, and the local authority should be able to issue a permit based solely on the documents you provide. Please leverage any mainstream analysis tools you prefer (e.g., STAAD, AutoCAD, Revit, or even hand calculations clearly scanned) and keep the final package clear, concise, and professional.

opportunities.title: Residential Second-Storey CAD Drafting
opportunities.description: I have an 80 m² second-storey addition planned for an existing double-brick home in Western Australia, and the structural engineer has already issued fully marked-up PDFs for every element. Your job is to turn those sketches into a polished, council-ready CAD package. Scope The commission covers a complete drawing set—plans, sections, elevations, plus all steel, timber, footing and connection details—nothing omitted. All structural design and calculations have been handled; this is only drafting. Software & Standards Please work in AutoCAD (or a fully compatible platform) and follow Australian residential structural drafting conventions for line weights, hatching, call-outs and title blocks. Clean layering, consistent dimensioning and clear cross-referencing between sheets are essential. Deliverables • Editable DWG files for every sheet • Final PDF set suitable for building approval Timeline I need the full package returned within 6 weeks of engagement, with interim PDFs for review as we progress. To be considered, highlight relevant experience producing residential structural drawings—especially second-storey additions or double-brick conversions—and note any familiarity with Australian Standards.

opportunities.title: Mapa Zone War Metro Tobalaba
opportunities.description: Quiero publicar un mapa de Zone Wars para 16 jugadores en UEFN / Fortnite Creative 2.0 ambientado en el entorno del Metro Tobalaba. El punto neurálgico será una cafetería Marley Coffee junto a la entrada del metro; alrededor se alzarán modelos inspirados en el Costanera Center y el Parque Titanium para dar referencia visual y verticalidad al combate. Además de la arquitectura, necesito integrar la marca “Marley RTD” dentro de la jugabilidad: • Dispensadores y visicoolers Marley calibrados a 4 °C que, al interactuar, entreguen latas RTD (Cappuccino, Caramel o Vainilla Latte). • Cada lata funcionará como un consumible rápido tipo Slurp Juice o Pepper: +25 de escudo y aumento temporal de velocidad/estamina con un destello ámbar que represente el “despabile” para rotaciones dentro de la tormenta. Requisitos técnicos clave: • Modo principal: Zone Wars competitivo por rondas. • Desarrollo íntegro en UEFN con lógica de tormenta, respawns y conteo de victorias. • Optimización para 16 jugadores simultáneos y fluidez en consolas. • Texturas y assets fieles a Santiago, manteniendo performance dentro de los límites de memoria. • Publicación y testing interno conmigo antes de enviar a Epic para la aprobación final. Entrego referencias fotográficas y lineamientos de marca; tú te ocupas de modelado, scripting (Verse), iluminación y balance de power-ups. Espero un mapa completamente funcional, listo para subir a la isla pública, más un paquete editable (.uasset) por si en el futuro hay que agregar campañas o skins de temporada. Tomando como base la ciudad de tilted towers.

opportunities.title: Sales Performance Excel Tracker
opportunities.description: I need an Excel workbook that lets me monitor overall sales health at a glance. The focus is on sales totals, targets, and month-by-month performance, with clear visual cues that show whether we are on track or falling behind. A simple dashboard with dynamic charts and conditional-format summaries is ideal; I should be able to drop new figures into a data sheet and have every metric update automatically. Core functionality I expect: • Data entry sheet for daily or weekly sales figures • Calculations that roll up into monthly and YTD totals versus target • Dashboard view featuring trend lines, progress-to-target gauges, and a quick-look table highlighting best and worst months • Light protection or drop-down validation so the file stays clean when others add data I’m happy to consider enhancements—perhaps adding customer contact or product-level breakouts later—but the first milestone is the high-level performance tracker described above. Please include samples of past work that show you have built Excel trackers or dashboards before; screenshots or a stripped-down file work fine. If you use Power Query, PivotTables, or VBA for automation, mention that too so I know what to expect. I’d like to kick this off right away and have an initial draft within a few days, then iterate once or twice until the layout feels intuitive and the numbers reconcile correctly.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40781436, publicado hace 11 horas (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: USD 15 - 25.

You’ll work independently once you’re comfortable, yet I’m always available on WhatsApp or email if questions pop up. Typical volume is one or two small batches per day, and I expect a quick acknowledgment whenever a new sheet is shared so I know you’ve received it. Looking forward to working together!

opportunities.title: Fetal Imaging 3D Reconstruction Platform
opportunities.description: # Medical Imaging & 3D Reconstruction Software Developer for AAKR --Project Overview I am seeking an experienced developer or small team to build a complete, secure, ready-to-use software application for **AAKR — “A memory takes shape.”** The goal is to convert suitable fetal medical imaging data into recognizable, full-body 3D fetal models. I am open to a web application or installable Windows desktop software. Please recommend the most cost-effective option, considering development, hardware, hosting, security and maintenance. **This project requires specialist medical-imaging and 3D-reconstruction expertise, not just general app development.** ## 1. Core Features The application should: - Import and process suitable fetal imaging data. - Reconstruct a full-body 3D model, including the head, torso, arms, hands, legs and feet wherever supported by the source data. - Preserve visible anatomy, proportions and natural fetal posture as accurately as possible. - Provide a rotatable, zoomable 3D preview. - Identify poor-quality scans and clearly flag estimated or reconstructed regions. - Export models in STL, OBJ and 3MF formats. - Scale models using reliable measurements when available. - Validate and clean the resulting 3D geometry. - Automatically delete uploaded scans and associated files after 30 days. - Provide a simple interface for authorized hospital personnel. The final deliverable must be a working, tested application—not merely a prototype or demonstration. ## 2. Imaging Inputs and Feasibility Please assess support for: - **3D/4D ultrasound** — preferred initial pathway. - **Fetal MRI** — additional pathway. - DICOM and NIfTI files. - JPEG, PNG and other common image formats where feasible. Ordinary 2D images may not contain enough depth information for accurate full-body reconstruction. The software must communicate these limitations rather than present invented anatomy as scan-derived. The intended coverage is pregnancy months 2–9. Please assess feasibility at each stage, particularly early pregnancy, and explain the required scan quality, expected accuracy and limitations. I do not currently have sample scans. You will need to identify legally usable research datasets and verify that they contain sufficient information for the intended reconstruction. Disclose dataset sources, permitted uses and license restrictions. ## 3. Technical Approach I am open to reusing proven tools, libraries and pretrained models where their licenses permit the intended commercial use. Potential technologies include Python, DICOM/NIfTI libraries, 3D Slicer, ITK/SimpleITK, VTK, PyTorch, MONAI and suitable mesh-processing tools. Please recommend an appropriate architecture and distinguish proven capabilities from features requiring research. A processing time of 5–10 minutes would be desirable, but accuracy and reliability take priority over speed. ## 4. Web vs Desktop Please compare both options and recommend the lowest-cost practical solution. **Desktop application: ** Windows installation, local processing where practical and clearly stated hardware requirements. **Web application: ** Browser-based access, secure accounts and permissions, suitable processing infrastructure, and transparent hosting and storage costs. Compare initial development, hardware, recurring costs, security, maintenance and future expansion. Do not assume either option is cheaper without evaluating the workload. ## 5. Security and Data Deletion The application must include: - Secure individual accounts and administrator-controlled access. - Appropriate protection for sensitive medical data. - Automatic deletion of scans and associated files after **30 days**. - Documented handling of temporary files, caches, backups and third-party services. - A tested deletion process and appropriate deletion records. - No transfer of scans to external AI services or third-party servers without prior written approval. Any exceptions to the 30-day deletion policy must be disclosed and agreed in advance. ## 6. Additional Geometry A future feature is to combine the reconstructed model with a transparent, rounded outer geometry and optional integrated text or logo geometry. Please identify whether this can be implemented reliably and quote it separately if it significantly increases development complexity. ## 7. Development Milestones Please propose a staged plan with separate deliverables for each phase: **Milestone 1 — Feasibility** - Identify suitable datasets and existing tools. - Assess ultrasound and MRI feasibility. - Review licensing requirements. - Demonstrate a credible reconstruction pathway using suitable data. - Document technical risks, hardware needs and limitations. **Milestone 2 — Core reconstruction** - Implement the agreed initial imaging pathway. - Generate and demonstrate a recognizable full-body model. - Report output quality and processing performance. **Milestone 3 — Application development** - Build the agreed web or desktop application. - Implement the preview, agreed export formats, access controls and 30-day deletion. - Complete the other agreed features. **Milestone 4 — Testing and handover** - Complete agreed acceptance tests. - Deliver the working application, source code and documentation. - Demonstrate installation or deployment. - Complete the agreed intellectual-property handover. ## 8. Final Deliverables The completed project must include: - Fully working, tested application and installer or deployment package. - Complete source code and build files. - Installation, configuration and troubleshooting instructions. - User and administrator documentation. - Agreed reconstruction, preview and export functionality. - Tested 30-day data-deletion mechanism. - Test results, sample outputs and documented limitations. - Dataset provenance and third-party software licence inventory. - Required credentials and configuration materials under the client's control. - Written intellectual-property assignment and agreed exclusive commercial-rights documentation. - A defined post-delivery defect-correction period. The application must run in the agreed environment without undocumented dependencies or ongoing developer intervention for ordinary use. ## 9. Ownership and Confidentiality The contractual objective is to secure exclusive commercial rights to custom-developed code and project-specific intellectual property, to the maximum extent legally available. The agreement should cover the rights to use, modify, maintain, license and commercially distribute the software, and to appoint other developers for future maintenance. All third-party code, pretrained models, datasets and license conditions must be disclosed. Any components that cannot be exclusively owned must be identified before approval. A written NDA and development agreement will be required. Patent assessment or filing is a separate legal matter and must not be assumed to be included. ## 10. Required Experience and Application Questions Preference will be given to developers with demonstrable experience in medical imaging, ultrasound or MRI processing, anatomical segmentation, 3D reconstruction, mesh processing and secure software development. Please answer these questions in your proposal: 1. What relevant medical-imaging and 3D reconstruction projects have you completed? Please share examples where permitted. 2. Have you generated full-body anatomical models from ultrasound or MRI data? 3. What technical approach and datasets would you recommend? 4. What are the main feasibility risks and limitations? 5. Which tools and pretrained models would you use, and what are their license conditions? 6. Would you recommend web or desktop software, and why? 7. What hardware and recurring operating costs would be required? 8. What timeline and deliverables do you propose for each milestone? 9. Will you provide complete source code, documentation and the agreed IP assignment? 10. What warranty and post-delivery support do you offer? opportunities.title: Comercial cierre servicios arboricultura
opportunities.description: Soy Enric, arborista profesional autónomo especializado en talas y podas complejas, con base en Palafrugell, Baix Empordà. Busco un perfil comercial freelance que capte y cierre proyectos grandes con empresas constructoras, inmobiliarias y gestores de fincas. Qué espero de tu labor: Prospección y contactos cualificados en el sector construcción y gestión de fincas. Negociación y cierre de acuerdos centrados en talas y desmontajes técnicos de arbolado, también previos a obras, y podas de grandes conjuntos de arbolado, como comunidades con decenas de pinos. Coordinación conmigo: el presupuesto técnico lo elaboro y emito yo. La visita para presupuestar es gratuita; los asesoramientos y cualquier otro servicio se cobran. Comisión: Mínimo del 10 % sobre el beneficio bruto de cada trabajo, a negociar según el proyecto. Lo que valoro: Experiencia en cierre de ventas y en venta B2B. Contactos en construcción, promotoras o arquitectura (indica casos concretos). Si te interesa, cuéntame tu experiencia y cómo trabajarías.

opportunities.title: Animasi AI Kisah Hidup Bertetangga -- 2
opportunities.description: Saya ingin memproduksi sebuah video hiburan berdurasi ±3–5 menit yang sepenuhnya digarap dan diedit dengan bantuan teknologi AI. Target penonton saya adalah dewasa, jadi nuansanya boleh lebih matang—humor satir, dialog cerdas, atau sudut pandang kritis—namun tetap ringan dan menghibur. Tema ceritanya berpusat pada kehidupan bertetangga di masyarakat: interaksi sehari-hari, konflik kecil, dan momen hangat yang bisa membuat penonton merasa dekat. Gaya visual saya terbuka: Anda boleh memilih 2D kartun yang ekspresif, 3D semi-realistis, atau pendekatan sinematik seperti film animasi, asalkan selaras dengan selera penonton dewasa dan dapat dicapai lewat pipeline AI (mis. generative art tools, motion capture AI, text-to-speech dubbing). Yang saya butuhkan: • Konsep cerita singkat + naskah dialog • Storyboard atau animatic untuk memastikan alur visual • Produksi animasi menggunakan workflow AI pilihan Anda (Contoh: Midjourney/Stable Diffusion untuk frame, Runway atau EbSynth untuk motion, Blender + add-ons, atau tool serupa) • Pengisian suara AI atau manusia (boleh bahasa Indonesia atau bilingual, sesuai rekomendasi) • Editing akhir lengkap dengan musik latar bebas lisensi, efek suara, color grading, dan teks terjemahan bila relevan • File final dalam resolusi Full HD (mp4) plus project source terstruktur Kriteria keberhasilan: – Humor dan alur mudah dipahami penonton 18+ – Visual konsisten dan bebas watermark AI – Audio jernih, level seimbang, tidak melanggar hak cipta Lampirkan portofolio karya animasi/AI sebelumnya, sebutkan tool yang biasa Anda pakai, dan perkiraan waktu pengerjaan. Saya siap berdiskusi lebih lanjut tentang tone cerita, durasi, maupun pendekatan teknik—silakan ajukan ide kreatif terbaik Anda!

opportunities.title: App gestión negocio con enlaces
opportunities.description: Necesito desarrollar una aplicación que me ayude a gestionar mi negocio y, sobre todo, que sirva como puerta de acceso a mis distintos sitios externos. La idea es que la app esté disponible tanto en Android como en iPhone y muestre, de forma ordenada, enlaces directos a mis páginas web y perfiles en redes sociales. Alcance principal • Pantalla inicial con el logo y un breve mensaje de bienvenida. • Menú o dashboard donde el usuario pueda tocar y abrir esos enlaces externos (páginas, redes). • Panel sencillo para que yo mismo pueda actualizar, añadir o quitar enlaces sin depender siempre del desarrollador. Entregables esperados – Código fuente completo (puede ser Flutter, React Native o similar). – Instaladores o builds listos para pruebas en Android y iOS. – Instrucciones claras de publicación en Google Play y App Store. Valoraré que la interfaz sea limpia, rápida y que siga las pautas básicas de usabilidad para móviles. Quedo atento a tus propuestas de tecnología, tiempo estimado y ejemplos de trabajos parecidos.

opportunities.title: 3D-Printed Electronics Enclosure Design
opportunities.description: I have a small electronics project that needs a purpose-built enclosure. Your task is to create the complete 3D CAD model for a plastic, 3D-printable housing and then generate clear, fully-dimensioned 2D drawings from that model. Scope of work • The enclosure will house circuit boards and related components. • It must include openings for all required cables and connectors plus internal mounting points for the boards. • I plan to print the part in standard FDM material (PLA/ABS), so wall thicknesses, draft angles, and tolerances should suit that process. Deliverables – Native CAD file (SolidWorks, Fusion 360, Inventor, or similar) – Exported STEP/IGES + STL ready for slicing – 2D manufacturing drawings with dimensions, tolerances, and a simple BOM if needed Acceptance criteria The model fits the board outline I will supply, mounting holes align, and all ports are accessible without post-processing beyond normal 3D-print cleanup. If you are comfortable with basic mechanical design and can turn around neat drawings quickly, I’d be happy to share the board layout and connector specs so you can get started right away.

opportunities.title: Buscamos teleoperadores con experiencia en ventas — Español neutro
opportunities.description: Buscamos profesionales con experiencia en ventas telefónicas para unirse a nuestra campaña de venta de servicios, dirigida a empresas y autónomos en España. El trabajo es completamente remoto y ofrecemos todas las herramientas y el apoyo necesario para el éxito. Responsabilidades principales: - Contactar proactivamente con empresas de nuestra base de datos. - Establecer comunicación con los dueños o responsables de negocio. - Identificar las necesidades de los clientes y presentar propuestas de servicios adecuadas. - Resolver dudas, gestionar objeciones y cerrar acuerdos de contratación. - Registrar detalladamente las llamadas y realizar seguimientos en el CRM. Facilitamos: - Acceso a una base de datos de empresas españolas. - CRM y sistema de llamadas integrado. - Guiones de venta y un proceso de venta estructurado. - Formación completa sobre nuestros servicios. - Material de apoyo y acompañamiento constante del equipo. Requisitos del perfil: - Mínimo dos años de experiencia comprobable en ventas telefónicas, en cualquier sector. - Dominio del español neutro, con pronunciación clara y excelente dicción. - Experiencia previa en ventas a empresas (B2B) es altamente valorada. - Habilidad para adaptar la conversación a las necesidades de cada cliente y cerrar ventas de manera efectiva. - Gran capacidad de constancia, organización y una fuerte orientación a objetivos. - Contar con ordenador, auriculares y una conexión a internet estable. Horario de trabajo: De lunes a viernes, de 9:00 a 14:00, hora peninsular de España. Categoría: Marketing Digital y Ventas Subcategoría: Televentas Tiempo requerido: Más de 20 horas

opportunities.title: AI Smart Glasses: Stealth Camera & Integrated Display
opportunities.description: Custom AI Smart Glasses Prototype Inspired by Even Realities G2 – Concealed Camera and Integrated Display Project Description I am looking for an experienced hardware engineer, multidisciplinary engineering team or product development company to design, manufacture, assemble, test and deliver one complete, fully functional physical prototype of custom AI smart glasses to Spain. The design should be inspired by the elegant, minimalist appearance of the Even Realities G2, with a conventional, lightweight eyeglass frame rather than a bulky AR headset. The key difference is that my prototype must include an integrated camera that is completely invisible and unrecognisable from the outside, while retaining the discreet appearance of ordinary eyeglasses. I require the finished physical product, not just CAD files, 3D models, renders, designs or consulting services. The successful applicant must deliver the fully assembled and working prototype to Spain. 1. Design and Appearance * Design inspired by the Even Realities G2: minimalist, elegant and discreet. * Conventional eyeglass appearance, with a slim frame and temples. * Custom black frame, with proportions and styling similar to premium everyday glasses. * Lightweight and comfortable for daily use. * Electronics integrated into the frame and temples without bulky external modules. * No visible camera modules, protruding lenses or obvious technological features. * Custom mechanical design to accommodate the camera, optical display, battery and electronics. The finished glasses should look as close as possible to normal premium eyeglasses. 2. Completely Concealed Camera The main custom feature is a functional camera integrated into the frame, preferably in the bridge between the lenses. Requirements: * The camera lens must be completely invisible and unrecognisable from the outside. * No protruding camera or obvious camera opening. * Suitable field of view and image quality for AI vision applications. * Functional image capture and/or video streaming to a smartphone. * Compact camera module and suitable electrical connections. * Integration that preserves the frame’s conventional appearance. The developer must propose a technically feasible optical solution that allows the camera to capture images without compromising its field of view or image quality. A visible recording indicator LED must activate whenever recording is taking place. It should be discreetly integrated into the frame while remaining visible when illuminated. 3. CAD files, renders or simulations alone are not acceptable as the final deliverable. 7. opportunities.title: Diseño Banco Pruebas Hidráulicas -- 2
opportunities.description: Necesito un diseño integral de un banco de pruebas para bombas hidráulicas que opere a alta presión. El sistema debe servir para verificar el desempeño de bombas de desplazamiento positivo, centrífugas y de engranajes, o cualquier otra variante que requiera mi línea de producción. Requisitos clave • Rango de trabajo: alta presión con capacidad de ajuste fino. • Funciones obligatorias: monitoreo de caudal en tiempo real y un módulo de calibración automática para agilizar los ensayos. • Instrumentación: sensores de presión y caudal, válvulas de seguridad, y una interfaz de control que permita registrar datos y generar reportes. • Integración posible con software de adquisición (por ejemplo LabVIEW o similar) y control mediante PLC. Entregables esperados - Planos mecánicos y esquemas hidráulicos listos para fabricación (formatos SolidWorks/AutoCAD o equivalente). - Diagrama eléctrico y lista de materiales con especificaciones de cada componente. - Lógica de control detallada, incluyendo rutinas de calibración y umbrales de alarma. - Manual de montaje, puesta en marcha y mantenimiento preventivo. Valoraré experiencia previa diseñando bancos de pruebas de alta presión, dominio de normativas de seguridad hidráulica y capacidad para acompañarme en ajustes posteriores si fuera necesario.

opportunities.title: Edición documental estilo Vox
opportunities.description: El proyecto consiste en convertir un guion ya redactado en un mini-documental de menos de 10 minutos para YouTube, con un tono claramente entretenido y ritmo dinámico inspirado en Johnny Harris, Vox y MagnatesMedia. La pieza debe: • Integrar gráficos y estadísticas que refuercen los datos clave, usando motion graphics limpios y modernos. • Combinar B-roll de archivo, cortes directos a cámara y música libre de derechos que mantenga la atención. • Respetar pautas de branding (colores y tipografías) que compartiré al iniciar. • Entregarse en 4K y en formato editable (Premiere Pro o DaVinci Resolve) junto con la versión final lista para publicar. Flujo que espero: 1. Definición de estructura y propuesta visual rápida. 2. Primera versión para feedback con marcadores de tiempo. 3. Una ronda de ajustes finos. El resultado final debe sentirse ágil, visualmente pulido y con narrativa clara, capaz de retener audiencia hasta el último segundo.

opportunities.title: Asistente Técnico WhatsApp Inteligente
opportunities.description: Necesito un asistente virtual conectado a mi número de WhatsApp Business que pueda responder en español con mensajes personalizados según el contexto de cada conversación. El objetivo principal es ofrecer soporte técnico a mis clientes sin respuestas genéricas ni basadas solo en palabras clave. Alcance: • Integración con la API de WhatsApp Business (o una plataforma como Twilio, 360dialog, etc.) para enviar y recibir mensajes. • Motor de procesamiento de lenguaje natural que entienda la intención del usuario, extraiga datos clave y genere réplicas coherentes y útiles. • Módulo de gestión de contexto que recuerde la conversación reciente para evitar respuestas repetitivas y mantener la coherencia técnica. • Base de conocimiento editable donde cargaré guías, preguntas frecuentes y procedimientos de soporte. • Panel sencillo de métricas: tiempo de respuesta, tickets resueltos y nivel de satisfacción. • Documentación paso a paso para que pueda actualizar respuestas o entrenar nuevos casos de uso sin depender siempre de un desarrollador. Criterios de aceptación: 1. Las respuestas deben ser siempre en español y adecuarse al tono profesional de soporte técnico. 2. Al recibir una pregunta fuera del alcance del bot, este debe escalarla a un agente humano y notificar al cliente. 3. El tiempo medio de respuesta automatizada no debe superar los 3 segundos. 4. Debe funcionar en un entorno de prueba antes del despliegue en producción. Cuento con hosting en la nube y puedo facilitar acceso si es necesario. Proporcionaré ejemplos de conversaciones reales para el entrenamiento inicial. Prefiero soluciones basadas en Python o Node.js, pero estoy abierto a la tecnología que mejor garantice estabilidad y fácil mantenimiento.

Alcance: • Integración con la API de WhatsApp Business (o una plataforma como Twilio, 360dialog, etc.) para enviar y recibir mensajes. • Motor de procesamiento de lenguaje natural que entienda la intención del usuario, extraiga datos clave y genere réplicas coherentes y útiles. • Módulo de gestión de contexto que recuerde la conversación reciente para evitar respuestas repetitivas y mantener la coherencia técnica. • Base de conocimiento editable donde cargaré guías, preguntas frecuentes y procedimientos de soporte. • Panel sencillo de métricas: tiempo de respuesta, tickets resueltos y nivel de satisfacción. • Documentación paso a paso para que pueda actualizar respuestas o entrenar nuevos casos de uso sin depender siempre de un desarrollador. Criterios de aceptación: 1. Las respuestas deben ser siempre en español y adecuarse al tono profesional de soporte técnico. 2. Al recibir una pregunta fuera del alcance del bot, este debe escalarla a un agente humano y notificar al cliente. 3. El tiempo medio de respuesta automatizada no debe superar los 3 segundos. 4. Debe funcionar en un entorno de prueba antes del despliegue en producción. Cuento con hosting en la nube y puedo facilitar acceso si es necesario. Proporcionaré ejemplos de conversaciones reales para el entrenamiento inicial. Prefiero soluciones basadas en Python o Node.js, pero estoy abierto a la tecnología que mejor garantice estabilidad y fácil mantenimiento."

opportunities.title: Value.com.do
opportunities.description: Quiero desarrollar un sitio web que combine las funcionalidades de Google Maps con un medidor de terrenos similar al de Google Earth y, además, integre inteligencia artificial para estimar el precio del suelo según la zona. Al ingresar al mapa, el usuario deberá poder: • Delimitar un polígono y ver de inmediato la superficie calculada. • Visualizar distintas áreas coloreadas de acuerdo con el rango de precios que la IA determine a partir del análisis de datos históricos. • Dibujar, editar y mover figuras sobre el mapa para ajustar mediciones con precisión. La capa de IA se alimentará de bases de datos históricas de compraventa; necesito que entrenes un modelo que procese esas fuentes y actualice las estimaciones en tiempo real o bajo demanda. La precisión y la rapidez de cómputo serán factores clave. Funcionalidades adicionales imprescindibles: • Generación de informes: exportar resumen de superficie, precio medio, precio total, y metadatos en PDF y/o Excel. • Herramientas de dibujo en el mapa para trazos libres, líneas, y puntos de referencia. • Opciones de exportación de datos: descargar shapefiles, GeoJSON o CSV de las áreas medidas e informes generados. Busco un diseño limpio, muy cercano a la experiencia visual de Google Maps: controles flotantes, interfaz intuitiva y respuesta ágil tanto en desktop como en móvil. Entregarás código fuente documentado, instrucciones de despliegue y un breve manual de usuario para que podamos continuar ampliando la plataforma en el futuro.

opportunities.title: Social Media Presenter for Jewellery Brand
opportunities.description: I'm looking for a casual and friendly presenter to showcase our necklaces and pendants, keyrings and cufflinks on Facebook, Instagram and TikTok. Key Responsibilities: - Presenting jewellery in a casual, friendly manner. - Creating content around seasonal collections, behind-the-scenes, and customer testimonials. - Being the face of our brand for Social media . Ideal Skills: - Experience in front of the camera. - Engaging personality. - Experience with Instagram and social media content creation. We're looking for a reliable UGC content creator to produce short-form videos (15–30 seconds) for my social channels. We do the planning: you’ll get each video idea or brief, plus the jewellery, props and anything else you need to film it, so your focus is on bringing it to life on camera in a natural, relatable way. Content centres on our handcrafted coin jewellery and the stories behind it- the coins in the jewellery being 'as old as them, fact and memories of years gone by', including birthdays, anniversaries and personalised gifts with real meaning. Consistency matters most to us. We're looking for someone who can deliver the agreed number of videos every week reliably, hit the deadlines we set together, and stay responsive on WhatsApp or DM so we can plan ahead. Videos should be well lit, clearly show the product, and be filmed in portrait for Reels and TikTok- all the things you already know and deliver.
